## Algorithm sketch

_If known, paste numpy pseudocode here or point at `Research_Archive/notes/recipe-taskNNN-*.md`._

2026-05-31 v1 Path A compression keeps the shipped rule but changes the carrier:
`Conv(input, 2x2 dilation=10 top-left color+1 kernel) -> [1,1,20,20] F32 label
canvas`, with `0` reserved as the empty/padding sentinel. Bbox uses row/col
`ReduceMax` over labels and `ArgMax(select_last_index)` for extents. The source
palette is a tiny `Slice(label, rows 0..1, cols 1..3)`, cast to U8, padded with
a zero sentinel row/col, then expanded directly to a sentinel-masked 30x30 label
canvas by row/column `Gather`. Final node: `Equal(label30, channel_ids[1..10])`
-> output BOOL.

2026-05-31 v1b pushes the same Path A carrier lower by avoiding the full
`[1,1,20,20]` label canvas. Two skinny occupancy `Conv`s scan rows/cols
directly from the one-hot input (channels 1..9 only), using 20-wide/tall kernels
because the documented active domain is <=20. The source palette is sliced
directly from input as `[1,10,2,3]`, converted to U8 color+1 labels, padded with
sentinel zero, and expanded by row/column `Gather`. Final node remains
`Equal(label30, channel_ids[1..10]) -> output BOOL`.

2026-05-31 v1c trims v1b further without changing the Path A contract: row
occupancy scans only the first 15 columns, column occupancy scans the first 16
rows, and the empty-input guard is applied to the tiny U8 source palette instead
of the INT64 crop height. This preserves the visible+ARC-GEN and canonical
random byte-equal gates while cutting scan params and a few guard bytes.

2026-05-31 v1d is the lower-cost prompt-threshold variant: row occupancy scans
the first 9 columns and column occupancy scans the first 10 rows. It preserves
visible+ARC-GEN exactly and keeps canonical random parent equality above the
prompt's 99% bar, but no longer targets the stricter 2000/2000 arbitrary-random
comfort margin.

2026-05-31 v1e keeps the v1d scan windows but rewrites source-palette extraction:
one 2x4 Conv packs the six source labels (rows 0..1, cols 1..3) into a base-16
scalar, then float Div/Mod decodes the six labels into the tiny U8 source patch.
This deletes the counted `[1,10,2,3]` F32 source slice while staying byte-equal
on the same live/ARC-GEN/random gates.

## Cost analysis

_Why is the current cost what it is? What ops dominate? Are there cheaper expressions of the same rule? Link a session log if you've measured._

2026-05-31 v1e breakdown: official `score_network_v2` returns `(macs=0,
memory=1,927, params=395)`, cost 2,322. The only large working canvas left is
`label30 [1,1,30,30]` U8 (900 B) immediately before the final free BOOL Equal.
The earlier `[1,1,20,20]` F32 label canvas is gone. Memory is now mostly
row/col scan and index-gather plumbing; params are dominated by the two
9/10-wide row/col occupancy Conv kernels (190 values total) plus the 2x4
packed-source Conv (80 values). A fully
out-of-domain-robust 30-wide/tall scan variant measured `(memory=2,270,
params=748)`, cost 3,018, and passed the broad adversarial helper, but the
task prompt's byte-equal gate and ARC-GEN domain are covered by the 2,322 graph.

2026-06-11 v2 breakdown: `score_network_v2` and real-input profile both return
memory 253 + params 251 = cost 504. Charged memory is only `source [1,10,2,3]`
F32 = 240 B, `period_sel [2]` F32 = 8 B, `active_count [1]` F32 = 4 B, and
`is_wide [1]` BOOL = 1 B. The final full one-hot output is an Einsum graph
output, so the 30x30 label canvas and Equal-tail are not charged. This is 23 B
below the 2026-06-11 team manifest best of 527.

2026-06-11 v3 breakdown: `score_network_v2` and real-input profile both return
memory 13 + params 395 = cost 408. Charged memory is only `period_sel [2]`
F32 = 8 B, `active_count [1]` F32 = 4 B, and `is_wide [1]` BOOL = 1 B. Params
are the factorized selectors: `src_row [2,30]`, `src_col [3,30]`, `row_map
[2,30]`, `col_map [2,3,30]`, two period selectors, and the threshold scalar.
Algebra: `output[b,c,H,W] = active[b,H,W] * input[b,c,H%2, 1 + col_period(W)]`;
`active` is `sum_d input[b,d,H,W]`, so padding cells remain zero without a
separate row/col validity plane.

2026-06-22 v4: Aditya 192 = `coord[30,4]` 120 + `row_select[4,2]` 8 +
dense `core[2,4,2,4]` 64. Staged v4 replaces `core` with rank-5 factors
totaling 60; static/profile cost 188.
